description: Defines the BackoffEntry class for managing exponential back-off logic in networking, including policy parameters and request rejection timing.

classes.name: BackoffEntry
classes.description: Manages exponential back-off timing for network requests based on a specified policy.

methods.name: InformOfRequest
methods.description: Informs the backoff object whether a request succeeded or failed.

methods.name: ShouldRejectRequest
methods.description: Determines if requests should be rejected based on current backoff state.

methods.name: GetReleaseTime
methods.description: Returns the absolute time when requests can be resumed.

methods.name: GetTimeUntilRelease
methods.description: Returns the time remaining until requests can be resumed.

methods.name: BackoffDurationToReleaseTime
methods.description: Converts a backoff duration into a release time.

methods.name: SetCustomReleaseTime
methods.description: Sets a custom time at which requests can be resumed.

methods.name: CanDiscard
methods.description: Checks if the backoff entry can be discarded due to inactivity.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the backoff entry to its initial state.

methods.name: GetTimeTicksNow
methods.description: Returns the current time, using the provided clock if available.
